data.title: Coalition Initiates Targeted Operation to Neutralize Houthi Threat Sources Targeting Civilians in Yemen and Saudi Arabia
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Official Spokesperson of the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen Major General Turki Al-Malki stated that a targeted operation has begun to neutralize sources of threats used to target civilians in Yemen and Saudi Arabia.
    He indicated that the operation includes neutralizing vital assets utilized by the terrorist Houthi militia to support its military efforts.
    -- SPA
17:15 Local Time 14:15 GMT
0052
